hook_text: 4 vetkoek cost R29. So do 10 cost R35? Not even close.
clip_script: A school vetkoek stall in East London. R6 each, plus R5 to deliver to your classroom. Flow diagram: times 6, then plus 5. 3 vetkoek? 18, then 23 rand. In a table, the top row is vetkoek, the bottom row is cost: 11, 17, 23, 29. Now 10 vetkoek. Do not just add 6 to 29. Use the rule: 10 times 6 is 60, plus 5 is 65 rand. A teacher paid R47? Undo it: minus 5 is 42, divided by 6 is 7 vetkoek. Words, flow diagram, table, number sentence. Four ways, one rule.
visual_style: Vetkoek dropping into a basket as prices fill a two-row table, with the skipped column glowing.
mood: Warm and busy, like break time at a school tuck shop.
pacing: Price one order, build the table, catch the skipped column, then run it backwards.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a price table for your own stall.
